metadata.er-tech-spec: title: looply · 社媒分享 实体关系图 version: v1.0 · 2026-06-03 tables: - name: short_links comment: 短链主表 note: 统一承载用户分享 + 运营投放两种短链 columns: - name: short_code comment: 短码（URL路径） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: long_url comment: 完整目标URL constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: link_type comment: 链接类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: utm_source comment: 渠道平台 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: utm_medium comment: 营销类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: utm_campaign comment: 活动类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: utm_content comment: 分享入口/账号 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: share_id comment: 分享事件ID constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: product_id comment: 商品ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sharer_user_id comment: 分享人用户ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: session_id comment: 匿名session constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_by comment: 运营创建人 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: campaign_name comment: 运营备注名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: click_count comment: 点击计数 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: unique_visitor_count comment: 独立访客数 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: share_clicks comment: 点击记录表 note: '' columns: - name: id comment: 自增主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: share_id comment: 关联短链 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: visitor_id comment: 匿名访客ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 登录用户ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: clicked_at comment: 点击时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ip comment: IP地址 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_agent comment: 浏览器UA constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: referer comment: 来源页面 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: share_attributions comment: 转化归因表 note: '' columns: - name: id comment: 自增主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: share_id comment: 关联短链 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 转化用户ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: event_type comment: 转化事件类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: gmv_cents comment: GMV（美分） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: attributed_at comment: 归因时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: products comment: 商品（外部） note: 商品模块提供，本模块只读 columns: - name: product_id comment: 商品ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: title comment: 商品标题 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: brand comment: 品牌 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: price_cents comment: 价格 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: image_url comment: 主图URL constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: users comment: 用户（外部） note: 用户模块提供，本模块只读 columns: - name: user_id comment: 用户ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: username comment: 用户名 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: orders comment: 订单（外部） note: 订单模块提供，本模块只读 columns: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 下单用户 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: total_cents comment: 订单金额 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: short_links to: share_clicks type: 1:N label: 被点击 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: short_links to: share_attributions type: 1:N label: 带来转化 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: short_links to: products type: N:1 label: 分享商品 color: '#90CAF9' - from: short_links to: users type: N:1 label: 分享人 color: '#90CAF9' - from: share_clicks to: users type: N:1 label: 点击者 color: '#90CAF9' style: dashed - from: share_attributions to: users type: N:1 label: 转化用户 color: '#F4A460' - from: share_attributions to: orders type: N:1 label: 归因订单 color: '#F4A460' design_rules: link_type_enum: link_type 枚举值：user_share（用户分享）/ marketing（运营投放） status_enum: status 枚举值：active / disabled / expired event_type_enum: event_type 枚举值：signup / first_order / repeat_order attribution_window: 归因窗口：点击→注册 7天，点击→下单 30天，多次点击取 Last Click cookie_ttl: Cookie _looply_ref 有效期 30 天，_looply_vid 持久化 short_code_format: 用户分享：sh_ + 6-8位Base62；运营创建：6-8位Base62 utm_medium_filter: GA4 筛选 utm_medium=social_share 可分离用户分享流量 og_strategy: MVP 阶段 OG 数据实时关联查 products 表，不冗余存储
